title: Special meeting to authorize closed session
subtitle: Closed session to cover land acquisition and disposition, and security of city property; no delegations or mayoral business.
overview: Kitchener City Council held a brief special meeting on March 23, 2026. It began at 4:34 p.m. and adjourned at 4:36 p.m. No council members declared a pecuniary interest, and there were no delegations or mayoral updates.

The only decision was to hold a closed (in-camera) meeting right after the special meeting {{vote:m1}}. It covers two land acquisition matters, two land acquisition and disposition matters, and one matter about security of property and information belonging to the city that has monetary value. The Municipal Act, 2001 allows councils to discuss these topics in private.

For residents, the meeting made no public decisions on those topics. The minutes report no outcomes from the closed session. Any later public action on these matters would come through a future council meeting.

decisions.detail: Council agreed to hold a closed meeting right after the special meeting to consider land acquisition, land acquisition and disposition, and city property security and valuable information matters {{vote:m1}}.

debate: There was no substantive debate. The chair asked for discussion on the motion to go in camera, and the transcript records none before the vote.
No delegations were heard, and no written comments were noted beyond the standard statement that any received had been circulated to council.
